scope: Exploratory activation analysis on synthetic language prompts; not a complete interpretation or biological validation.

concept.name: low_oxygen_language_contrast
concept.method: Mean residual-stream difference at the final prompt token

interpretation: Layer 10 perfectly ranked eight held-out prompts from the same authored prompt family. Adding the measured direction increased the Yes-minus-No next-token logit margin on all four held-out negative prompts, with mean change 0.40625 and range 0.25 to 0.75. This is evidence of linear separability and model sensitivity, not proof of a stable semantic feature or complete causal circuit.
limitations: A linear direction can encode lexical or formatting correlations rather than a stable human concept.
The held-out set contains only eight synthetic prompts from the same authored prompt family.
Residual intervention demonstrates sensitivity, not a complete causal circuit or semantic proof.
Results on Gemma 3 270M do not establish behavior of Gemma 4 31B or another checkpoint.
The bfloat16 results are not claimed to be numerically identical across hardware, drivers, or library versions.
No GMP, process-control, product-quality, clinical, or patient-safety conclusion is supported.
